commercialRationale: Tranche 2 is the first official_pdf_fill implementation on the platform. Tranche 1 proved the custom-pleading lane end to end; nothing had yet proved that LegalEase can take a current official state form, fill only the participant's own fields, leave every third-party field blank, and hand the participant one assembled PDF. Maryland is the right jurisdiction for that proof: it is a large statewide market on MDEC e-filing, its Judiciary publishes Rules-approved forms the clerks are built around, and its normalized legal design expressly forbids substituting a custom pleading for those forms. The selected route also carries the highest per-participant value in the Maryland set — Second Chance Act shielding is once per lifetime, so a defective packet is unrecoverable, which is exactly the kind of output that must be proved before it is sold.
technicalRationale: The selected route exercises the whole official-form lane in one packet: two distinct current official AcroForm layouts, a required companion form the primary form's own text demands, a court-level branch that changes both forms, twelve mutually independent offence branches, a dropdown constrained to the court's own option list, participant case-number packing with a hard overflow stop, and a set of third-party blocks — attorney appearance, petitioner signature, signature dates, court-order date — that must come out of the renderer blank.
selectionMethod: Deterministic. The candidate set is the six normalized Maryland relief tracks whose output strategy is official_pdf_fill. Each candidate's packet components were resolved against the Edition 1.2 master asset manifest through the authority loader. A candidate survives only where every one of its required participant-facing components maps to a retained asset whose asset_class is packet_form — that is, an approved packet candidate that is not source-gated, reference-only, retired, excluded, superseded or commercially restricted. Five of the six fail that test on their primary filing. One survives.

candidatesConsidered.reason: Both components — CC-DC-CR-148 as primary filing and MDJ-008 as the required companion notice — are retained Edition 1.2 packet_form assets with packetCandidate true, correct document role and correct language. Its only mechanical authority defect was that neither track source relationship pinned a SHA-256. That is closed by this tranche.

The required participant-facing primary filing maps to MD:CC-DC-CR-072A:PRIMARY_FILING:EN, retained under STATES/MD/05_SOURCE_GATED/ with assetClass source_gated and packetCandidate false. Edition 1.2's resolverSelectionRule states a source-gated asset is never resolver-selectable. The Maryland Edition 1.2 controlling addendum records why: the printed revisions of the CC-DC-CR-072 family could not be re-confirmed against the Maryland Judiciary in that pass, which is what makes them source-gated rather than packet-form candidates. The gate is not mechanically resolvable inside this repository — it is closed by re-acquiring and re-confirming the form with the publisher and publishing a new edition, and this task may not publish Edition 1.3.

Same source gate on the primary filing, MD:CC-DC-CR-072C:PRIMARY_FILING:EN. Its conditional attachment CC-DC-CR-078 is a clean packet_form candidate, but a General Waiver and Release is not a petition and cannot be delivered as a packet without the petition it attaches to.

Same source gate on the primary filing, MD:CC-DC-CR-072B:PRIMARY_FILING:EN. Its conditional fee-waiver component CC-DC-089 is a clean packet_form candidate. Excluding this track is what costs the tranche its conditional fee-waiver coverage; a fee waiver alone is not a relief route.

Same source gate on the primary filing, MD:CC-DC-CR-072D:PRIMARY_FILING:EN. Independently carries an open release blocker on the filing fee: the Judiciary self-help page states $30 while the form covers dispositions the internal reference treats as free.

Same source gate on the primary filing, MD:CC-DC-CR-072B:PRIMARY_FILING:EN. Independently carries an open release blocker on whether the June 2024 mass cannabis pardon satisfies § 10-105(a)(8), and it would have reused a layout already covered by md_10110_conviction.

trackCountDeviation.requested: four or five official_pdf_fill relief tracks
trackCountDeviation.statement: Maryland cannot supply four viable packet tracks under Master Library Edition 1.2. Five of its six official_pdf_fill tracks depend on a CC-DC-CR-072-family primary filing, and Edition 1.2 retains all four members of that family as source_gated assets that are never resolver-selectable. No eligible Maryland official-form route remains to substitute. Maryland's whole Edition 1.2 footprint is eleven assets, of which four are packet_form: CC-DC-CR-148, MDJ-008, CC-DC-CR-078 and CC-DC-089. Only CC-DC-CR-148 commences a relief proceeding — MDJ-008 is a companion e-filing notice, CC-DC-CR-078 is the General Waiver and Release that attaches to CC-DC-CR-072C, and CC-DC-089 is a Request for Waiver of Prepaid Costs. CC-DC-089 does carry document_role PETITION in the manifest, which is a mis-role for a fee-waiver request: any filter written as packet_form AND role PETITION returns two Maryland rows, and the second is not a relief petition. The tranche was not padded: no process-guidance route was converted, no closed-window route was reopened, and no source-gated asset was reclassified to reach a count.
trackCountDeviation.whatWouldUnblockTheRest: Re-acquire CC-DC-CR-072A, CC-DC-CR-072B, CC-DC-CR-072C and CC-DC-CR-072D from the Maryland Judiciary, confirm each printed revision with the publisher, and retain them as packet_form assets in a future Master Library edition. That would make four further Maryland routes selectable in one pass and is the single highest-value source acquisition in the Maryland backlog.

Two generated legal-design files did change content, and neither carries a conclusion: the track source relationships gained the two SHA-256 pins, and the specification set gained one authored process-guidance specification for the packet's instructions component — the same mechanism Tranche 1 used, and the reason it exists is that the generator emits no specification for a guidance component sitting inside an official-form track. No normalized track object, no eligibility rule, no venue, no scope restriction and no output strategy was edited.

The remaining blocking reason changes from a repository defect to the edition's own release posture.
